meta.title: ASSETRA Club | Investment Opportunities Before Public Offering
meta.description: Join the ASSETRA Club and receive information about selected investment opportunities (real estate, company acquisitions, secured loans) before they go public.

earlyAccess.title: Early access
earlyAccess.text: We send you selected opportunities before they go public.

noCommitment.title: No commitments
noCommitment.text: Membership is free. No fees, no commissions. You respond only when you want to.

preferences.title: Your preferences
preferences.text: We only send what matches your profile — type, scope, and horizon.

discretion.title: Discretion
discretion.text: Specific details are shared under NDA. We do not share your data with anyone.

intro: After free registration, we will send you a selection of interesting investment opportunities — property buyouts, real estate project financing, and acquisitions of established Slovak companies. Only when there is something that matches your profile.

form.heading: Registration
form.title: Join the club
form.description: It takes 2 minutes to complete. We only send when there is something interesting — no spam.
form.interests: What opportunities are you interested in? *

consent: I consent to the processing of my personal data for the purposes of receiving investment opportunities in accordance with the privacy policy. You can unsubscribe at any time.

success.title: You're in the club
success.text: Thank you. We will reach out when there is something interesting.
